    Format[edit]

    Seasonal Format

    • 30 teams in each region will be seeded into three groups of ten teams each using Year 2 ALGS and Preseason Qualifier performance
      • Teams compete in a double round-robin format (Each group plays each other group three times)
      • Each team will play 36 games in the Regular Season
      • Series consists of six games each
    • After 36 games, each team will rank by their Post Match Series Points (see below).
    • Top 20 teams of the 36 games will play an additional match called Regional Final.
    • Regional Final will be using Match point system, and also give Post Match Series Points.
    • The eventual rankings will be determined after the Regional Final, ranked by their Post Match Series Points.
    • The top 4 teams and the winner of regional final will advance to the playoffs.
